about.title: About Akademia
about.subtitle: A legacy of academic excellence, innovation, and community since 1998
about.builtForFuture: A University Built for the Future
about.overview1: Founded in 1998, Akademia University has grown from a small institution with a bold vision into one of the most respected universities in the region. With five faculties, over 45 study programs, and a vibrant community of 12,000 students, we are committed to fostering critical thinking, creativity, and social responsibility.
about.overview2: Our campus is a hub of intellectual discovery where students, faculty, and researchers collaborate on projects that address real-world challenges — from sustainable energy to public health innovation. We believe education should not only open doors but also empower individuals to create new ones.
about.missionText: To provide transformative education that equips students with the knowledge, skills, and values needed to lead meaningful lives and contribute to society. We are dedicated to advancing knowledge through research, fostering innovation, and nurturing a diverse and inclusive academic community.
about.visionText: To be recognized as a leading university in Southeast Europe — a center of academic excellence, groundbreaking research, and positive social impact. We envision graduates who are globally competitive, ethically grounded, and equipped to shape a more just and sustainable world.
about.academicExcellenceDesc: Rigorous standards and continuous pursuit of knowledge.
about.inclusivityDesc: A welcoming environment for students of all backgrounds.
about.globalPerspectiveDesc: Preparing citizens for an interconnected world.
about.integrityDesc: Ethical conduct in research, teaching, and governance.
about.leadershipSub: Meet the people guiding Akademia's mission

admissions.req1: High school diploma or equivalent (for Bachelor programs)
admissions.req2: Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution (for Master programs)
admissions.req6: Two letters of recommendation (for graduate programs)
admissions.req7: English language proficiency certificate (IELTS 6.0+ or TOEFL 80+)
